text: {"assertions":["billing/invoice_totals.py had an off-by-one cent error that only occurred for records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause was an exception being swallowed by a bare except clause.","The error could be reproduced by totaling an invoice with three prorated lines.","The one-cent discrepancy was detected as a gap in the reconciliation report.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler to let the failure propagate.","PR #2848 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1 contained the fix.","The fix eliminated 50 duplicate rows per day that had been written to the database.","This was a recurring issue in the same area of billing/invoice_totals.py where off-by-one cent problems had occurred before."]}
